title: Decent for the Price
text: Decent for the Price. This milk frother has worked well for me. However, it is difficult to clean, especially the bottom where the milk burns against the metal. It seems fairly well-made, but I have only used it a couple of times.

product_metadata.title: Milk Steamer, WETIE Milk Frother 5-in-1 Electric Milk Steamer Frothing 13.5oz Hot/Cold Milk Foam Aerating Red Wine Milk Warmer for Latte, Cappuccinos, Macchiato, Hot Chocolate Milk, Foam Maker, 120V
features: ❤【5-in-1 Multifunction】WETIE milk frother and steamer combines frothing hot milk, frothing cold milk, heating milk, heating chocolate, and aerating red wine; the versatile milk frother allows you to make barista-level coffee and milk beverages right at your home.

❤【Delicate Froth in 2 Minutes】This powerful 500W milk frother creates smooth and silky foam in 2 minutes with almost no noise produced (less than 50dB); Perfect for making milk foam for your latte, cappuccino and macchiatos at home; Pure milk (Fat content>6%) is recommended.

❤【13.5oz Capacity 】The milk frother comes with a large cup which makes 5oz milk foam at one time, allowing you to share the aroma of coffee drinks with your families and friends at home or in the office; the milk steamer can heat 13.5 oz milk to the perfect temperature for drinking.

❤【Customer-Friendly Design】Easy to clean with internal non-stick jug surface, just rinse directly under running water for effortless cleaning; Dripless spout prevents liquid leakage; The transparent viewing lid allows you to check the whole frothing process at a glance. Milk steamer with buzzer reminds you to get your warm milk or delicious froth in time.

❤【Safe to Use】ETL certificated and equipped with temperature controls, it would automatically shut off when the temperature of milk foam is hot enough or when there is no operation in 5 minutes; food-grade stainless steel for the ultimate confidence in the use.
